qs.q: Autoimmune Polyendocrine Syndrome Type 1 (APS-1) includes all of the following EXCEPT
qs.e: APS-1 (APECED) = AIRE gene mutation (autosomal recessive). Classic triad: Chronic mucocutaneous Candidiasis + Hypoparathyroidism + Adrenal insufficiency (Addison's). Causes HYPOcalcemia (not hypercalcemia) due to hypoparathyroidism. Also: type 1 DM, hypothyroidism, gonadal failure, alopecia, vitiligo.
